title: WJEC GCSE Maths & Numeracy Double Award: A Parent Guide
description: Understand the new WJEC GCSE Mathematics and Numeracy Double Award, how to check your child’s qualification and how to plan useful revision.
excerpt: What changed in Made-for-Wales Maths, why the exact qualification matters and practical ways to begin revision.

title: Why GCSE Physics Equations Feel Hard (and How to Improve)
description: Help for GCSE Physics students struggling with equations, units and rearranging formulae, with a clear worked example and practical revision advice.

title: How to Choose an Online Tutor in Cardiff, Swansea or Newport
description: A practical checklist for South Wales parents choosing a GCSE or A-Level online tutor in Maths, Physics, English or Science.

title: GCSE Mock Revision Plan: What to Do After a Difficult Paper
description: A manageable GCSE mock revision plan for WJEC and other UK exam boards. Find knowledge gaps, use feedback and plan realistic practice before the next assessment.
